# INV-USD-001 linked to the transaction that still holds a CAD fee.
#
# Names the parked split outright, which is what says "this one settles the
# invoice, the fee is not mine" — the fee split is left alone whatever happens
# here. The refusal is not about being unable to tell the two apart; the block
# says which. It is that the entry cannot be quoted in USD with a CAD fee in
# it, so the settlement's value would have to be a CAD figure nobody stated.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming USD and CAD.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-26
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "7d3e1f9a4b6c48d2a1e05f8c2b7d4a63"
    txn_split_guid: "4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f809122334"
